sloka: सम्भाषणाथ च मया जानक्याश्चिन्तितो विधिः ।इक्ष्वाकूणां हि वशस्तु ततो मम पुरस्कृतः ।। ५.५८.९२ ।।।।
transliteration: sambhāṣaṇātha ca mayā jānakyāścintito vidhiḥ ।ikṣvākūṇāṁ hi vaśastu tato mama puraskṛtaḥ ।। 5.58.92 ।।।।

translations.english: "The divine lady heard my enumeration, sanctifying the royal seers. She replied me, with her eyes blinded by tears:
